subject: Question about my membership plan
body: Hi, I'm hoping you can help me figure something out. I signed up for a membership plan a while back, maybe a few months ago, and I'm a little confused about what's actually included. I thought I knew but now I'm second-guessing myself. There was something about the benefits changing or maybe I misread it. Anyway, I'd just like someone to walk me through what my plan covers so I know what I'm paying for. I don't have my details handy right now but can dig them up if you need them. Thanks.
